items: When an erasure ticket says to delete 'any aliases that route to her' I want the exact alias list confirmed first; a vague object set has caught us deleting the wrong routing entry before.
We had an erasure run that quietly removed an alias still referenced in an open matter, so I now want the records owner to eyeball each routing alias before it goes.
Same-day erasure pressure from HR is exactly when scope mistakes happen, so I treat 'delete any aliases' as something to itemise and confirm rather than sweep.
Our erasure runbook treats a routing alias whose only destination is the erasure subject as in-scope cleanup; once the alias list shows a single destination there is nothing left to confirm.
I own the GDPR intake desk and routinely clear single-destination aliases tied to an erased mailbox; that bounded routing cleanup is pre-approved on my side.
When an alias resolves to just the departing person and nobody else, removing it is the expected finish to the erasure and does not need a separate sign-off from me.
